title: AuditResultManifest
description: Stable wire format for the JSON line emitted by `ignorantia audit`. Mirrors application.dtos.RunAuditResult.

timestamp_iso8601.description: When the entry was recorded (ISO-8601 UTC, e.g. 2026-05-07T22:30:00Z).
